extra.message: Cache/lookup key appears to be built by directly concatenating two request-derived values (via an f-string) with no delimiter between them. If both values are attacker-controlled and variable-length, this may be vulnerable to the cache key injection pattern described in docs/01-background.md: an attacker can shift characters across the fragment boundary to collide two different requests onto the same key. Verify whether a separator exists and whether it's safe (see docs/06-static-analysis-dataflow.md, "Delimiters can be unsafe too").
